infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Loadit uses the microphone so you can speak your money requests to HQ, and for ultrasonic Pulse pairing with nearby phones.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Loadit uses the camera to scan a nearby phone's Pulse code so you can collect money offline.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Loadit uses Bluetooth so you can send and receive money with people near you — even with no internet.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Loadit advertises over Bluetooth so nearby phones can pay you offline.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Loadit uses your location to find people nearby to pay and to verify offline Pulse claims.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Loadit hands money to nearby phones over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi — even with no internet.
